name: Hypothetical Comical Queers
source:
A visual novel about LGBTQ+ comics! Meet whacky and queer characters from a variety of comic genres as you discover your own identity!

[From [url=https://phantomauve.itch.io/hypothetical-comical-queers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于LGBTQ+ 漫画的视觉小说！当你发现自己的身份时，会遇到来自各种漫画流派的古怪和酷儿角色！

[来自[url=https://phantomauve.itch.io/hypothetical-comical-queers]Itch.io[/url]]
